Who We Are

Mission & Vision

Mission

To effectively provide the Government of Palau with the revenue necessary to meet the needs of the People of Palau.

Vision

We are trusted by our community as an organization known for being fair, effective, efficient, and transparent.

Who We Are

Our Values

Service Oriented

We help every taxpayer meet their obligations — accessible, convenient, and courteous, every time.

Leadership

A clear, visible standard of integrity and professionalism — and a culture of high performance, led from the front.

Working in Partnership

We build effective relationships, inside BRT and beyond it, to get more done together.

Valuing Employees

Education, training, and real opportunities to grow — an empowered team is a productive one.

Continuous Improvement

We seek out new perspectives and keep evaluating our processes — always learning, always improving.

Results Focused

We're accountable for our performance — every measure, every outcome, owned and reported openly.
